dirList.profile:
Nandika has over 35 years post qualifying experience in the Banking, Telecommunication and Audit & Assurance industries. He was the Chief Financial Officer of Commercial Bank of Ceylon PLC until May 2025 having worked as the CFO for over 17 years. He was the Chief Financial Officer of Mobitel (Pvt) Ltd before joining the Commercial Bank. Nandika is an alumna of KPMG having worked in Colombo, Maldives and Oman. He is a current Council Member of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and former Council Member of the University of Colombo. Nandika is a Board Member & Trustee of the Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment, UK and the Chairman of the CISI National Advisory Committee, Sri Lanka. Nandika serves as a Non-Executive Independent Director to Sarvodaya Development Finance PLC and a Consultant to Asian Development Bank. He was the Chairman of the ACCA Member Network Panel - Sri Lanka, President of the National Chamber of Commerce (NCCSL) and a Vice President of Organization of Professional Associations of Sri Lanka (OPASL). He is a current member of Study Boards of MSc in Financial Mathematics and BSc in Financial Engineering, Mathematics Dept. of the University of Colombo and a member of the ACCA Global Forum for Education. He is the current Chairman of the Banking, Finance & Insurance Committee of CMA Sri Lanka and a member of the various committees of CA Sri Lanka including Financial Reporting Standards Interpretation & Implementation Committee (FRSII). Nandika was a Member of the Governing Council of National Institute of Business Management (NIBM) and Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Monitoring Board (SLAASMB). 

He obtained his first degree in BSc Business Administration and Post Graduate Diploma in Management from the University of Sri Jayewardenepura and MBA, M.A. in Financial Economics, MSc in Financial Mathematics from the University of Colombo. He is a Fellow Member of CA Sri Lanka, ACCA (UK), CMA, CMA (Aust.) and a Member of CISI (UK).
